v3.0.1 Update
Fixed empty Action Menu categories being hidden unexpectedly after updating to 3.0. They remain visible unless Automatically Hide Empty Categories is enabled.
Items dropped into custom menus, including entries saved in 3.0, use system macros again. Players can add them without creating folders or replacing hotbar shortcuts.
Dropping an Item already saved in a personal tab keeps its entry and favorites without adding a duplicate, including entries inherited by unlinked tokens.
Saved Draw Steel Items reuse their macros. WFRP4e Items without native roll macros can still be added.
PF2e and Starfinder 2e sheet attacks can be dropped into custom tabs or onto the HUD as favorites, including Solar Weapon, Solar Flare, NPC attacks, and Elemental Blast. Drops use the source token's attack list.
Saved attacks remain distinct when the attack list changes and recover when an unavailable attack returns. Existing Strike favorites retain their stars, filtering, reordering, and removal controls.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v3.0.1
announcement.content:
v3.0.1 fixes hidden categories, Item shortcuts, and PF2e and Starfinder 2e attack drops.

  • Fixed empty Action Menu categories being hidden unexpectedly after updating to 3.0. They remain visible unless Automatically Hide Empty Categories is enabled.
  • Items dropped into custom menus, including entries saved in 3.0, use system macros again. Players can add them without creating folders or replacing hotbar shortcuts.
  • Dropping an Item already saved in a personal tab keeps its entry and favorites without adding a duplicate, including entries inherited by unlinked tokens.
  • Saved Draw Steel Items reuse their macros. WFRP4e Items without native roll macros can still be added.
  • PF2e and Starfinder 2e sheet attacks can be dropped into custom tabs or onto the HUD as favorites, including Solar Weapon, Solar Flare, NPC attacks, and Elemental Blast. Drops use the source token's attack list.
  • Saved attacks remain distinct when the attack list changes and recover when an unavailable attack returns. Existing Strike favorites retain their stars, filtering, reordering, and removal controls.
